keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «남동생이 공원에서 길을 잃는다(문제)» 와 «스파키가 동생을 찾았다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (my little brother is lost in the park) and the solution (Sparky finds him). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why does the family need Sparky's help?
opts: They cannot find the little brother.
Grandpa is lost in the park.
evs: Grandpa gives me a robot dog named Sparky.
We look everywhere, but we cannot find him.
Sparky found my brother. He is a real hero!
why: 여기저기 찾아봐도 동생을 찾을 수 없었어요. 그래서 스파키의 도움이 필요했어요.
They look everywhere, but they cannot find the brother. So they need Sparky.

qs.q: "Sniff, sniff! Beep, beep!" What is Sparky doing here?
qs.qko: «Sniff, sniff! Beep, beep!» 에서 스파키는 무엇을 하고 있나요?
opts: smelling the hat to find the brother
evs: One day, my little brother is lost in the park.
I give Sparky my brother's hat.
There is my brother, sitting by the pond!
Grandpa gives me a robot dog named Sparky.
why: 바로 앞에서 스파키가 동생 모자를 받았어요. «Sniff, sniff!» 는 모자 냄새를 맡는 소리예요.
Sparky just got the brother's hat. "Sniff, sniff!" is the sound of Sparky smelling it.

qs.q: How does Sparky find the little brother?
opts: He smells the hat and runs into the trees.
evs: I give Sparky my brother's hat.
We look everywhere, but we cannot find him.
Grandpa gives me a robot dog named Sparky.
why: 스파키가 동생 모자 냄새를 맡고, 나무 사이로 달려가요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Sparky gets the brother's hat, and then he runs into the trees. You need both sentences.

ends: Sparky helps find Grandpa's lost glasses.
스파키가 할아버지의 잃어버린 안경을 찾아 준다.
Sparky and my brother play hide-and-seek in the park.

write.src: “I think <u>Sparky is a hero</u> because <u>he finds my brother</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: In a sunny park, Sparky, a shiny silver robot dog with round blue glowing eyes, short metal legs and a red collar, leaps out from between tall trees toward a pond, where a little boy with curly brown hair in a green striped shirt sits on the grass and turns around with a big surprised smile, while a girl with a long black ponytail in a purple jacket runs behind, holding a blue baseball cap.

scenes.1: In a big park with benches and bushes, a girl with a long black ponytail in a purple jacket kneels down and holds a blue baseball cap up to the nose of Sparky, a shiny silver robot dog with round blue glowing eyes, short metal legs and a red collar, while an old man with white hair and glasses looks under a bench with a worried face.
scenes.2: By a pond with lily pads, Sparky, a shiny silver robot dog with round blue glowing eyes, short metal legs and a red collar, stands proudly as a little boy with curly brown hair in a green striped shirt hugs him, and a girl with a long black ponytail in a purple jacket runs out of the trees with open arms.
